DecimalWire.description:
Exact decimal encoded only as a JSON string.

Restoration routes through [`crate::decimal::parse_decimal`], the single
exact text-admission rule: JSON numbers, malformed text and inexact values
are rejected rather than rounded. Serialization writes canonical
fixed-point text with trailing zeros removed and signed zero normalized
(`"1.5"`, `"0"`), never scientific notation.

description: Capital-structure inputs of a weighted-average cost of capital calculation.

cost_of_debt.description:
**Pre-tax** cost of debt in decimal form: the marginal borrowing yield
before the tax shield (`0.06` means `6%`).

cost_of_equity.description:
Required return on equity in decimal form, typically from CAPM
(`0.115` means `11.5%`).

debt_weight.description:
Debt share of total capital as a decimal fraction (`0.4` means 40%
debt-funded); non-negative, and sums with `equity_weight` to `1.0`.

equity_weight.description:
Equity share of total capital as a decimal fraction (`0.6` means 60%
equity-funded); non-negative.

tax_rate.description:
Marginal corporate tax rate as a decimal fraction in `[0, 1]` (`0.25`
means `25%`).

title: WaccInputs
